mapper.select: SELECT id, content, metadata::text AS metadata FROM chunk_bge_m3 WHERE bm25_index_version IS NULL AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(content), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE chunk_bge_m3 SET title_bm25_vector = #{titleBm25Vector}::bm25_catalog.bm25vector, content_bm25_vector = #{contentBm25Vector}::bm25_catalog.bm25vector, bm25_index_version = #{bm25IndexVersion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND bm25_index_version IS NULL
